AffineBranch.eval_zero
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem AffineBranch.eval_zero {d : ℕ} (a : AffineBranch d) :
    a.eval (fun _ => 0) = (a.constant : ℝ) :=

all_public_private_headers.name: AffineBranch.eval_basis
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem AffineBranch.eval_basis {d : ℕ} (a : AffineBranch d) (j : Fin d) :
    a.eval (fun i => if i = j then 1 else 0) =
      (a.constant : ℝ) + (a.slope j : ℝ) :=

all_public_private_headers.name: AffineBranch.eq_of_eval_eq_all
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem AffineBranch.eq_of_eval_eq_all {d : ℕ} {a b : AffineBranch d}
    (h : ∀ x : Point d, a.eval x = b.eval x) : a = b :=

all_public_private_headers.name: AffineBranch.tieSet_eq_univ_iff
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem AffineBranch.tieSet_eq_univ_iff {d : ℕ} (a b : AffineBranch d) :
    a.tieSet b = Set.univ ↔ a = b :=

AffineBranch.continuous_eval
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem AffineBranch.continuous_eval {d : ℕ} (a : AffineBranch d) :

all_public_private_headers.name: AffineBranch.tieSet_closed
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem AffineBranch.tieSet_closed {d : ℕ} (a b : AffineBranch d) :
    IsClosed (a.tieSet b) :=

all_public_private_headers.name: AffineBranch.mem_tieSet_iff
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem AffineBranch.mem_tieSet_iff {d : ℕ}
    (a b : AffineBranch d) (x : Point d) :
    x ∈ a.tieSet b ↔
      (∑ i : Fin d, ((a.slope i - b.slope i : ℚ) : ℝ) * x i) =
        ((b.constant - a.constant : ℚ) : ℝ) :=

all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem keepOrRaise_ge_left {d : ℕ} (x : Point d)
    (current next : LabeledBranch d) :
    current.value x ≤ (keepOrRaise x current next).value x :=

all_public_private_headers.name: keepOrRaise_ge_right
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem keepOrRaise_ge_right {d : ℕ} (x : Point d)
    (current next : LabeledBranch d) :
    next.value x ≤ (keepOrRaise x current next).value x :=

all_public_private_headers.name: scan_ge_start
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem scan_ge_start {d : ℕ} (x : Point d)
    (current : LabeledBranch d) (rest : List (LabeledBranch d)) :
    current.value x ≤ (scan x current rest).value x :=

all_public_private_headers.name: scan_ge_member
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem scan_ge_member {d : ℕ} (x : Point d)
    (current : LabeledBranch d) (rest : List (LabeledBranch d))
    {next : LabeledBranch d} (hnext : next ∈ rest) :
    next.value x ≤ (scan x current rest).value x :=

all_public_private_headers.name: scan_eq_start_of_all_le
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem scan_eq_start_of_all_le {d : ℕ} (x : Point d)
    (current : LabeledBranch d) (rest : List (LabeledBranch d))
    (h : ∀ b ∈ rest, b.value x ≤ current.value x) :
    scan x current rest = current :=

all_public_private_headers.name: selected_none_of_all_le
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem selected_none_of_all_le {d : ℕ}
    (base : LabeledBranch d) (rest : List (LabeledBranch d))
    (x : Point d) (h : ∀ b ∈ rest, b.value x ≤ base.value x) :
    selected base rest x = none :=

all_public_private_headers.name: selected_none_of_identical_branches
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem selected_none_of_identical_branches {d : ℕ}
    (base : LabeledBranch d) (rest : List (LabeledBranch d))
    (x : Point d) (h : ∀ b ∈ rest, b.cap = base.cap) :
    selected base rest x = none :=

all_public_private_headers.name: distinct_equal_values_mem_wall
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem distinct_equal_values_mem_wall {d : ℕ}
    (base : LabeledBranch d) (rest : List (LabeledBranch d))
    {a b : LabeledBranch d} (ha : a ∈ base :: rest)
    (hb : b ∈ base :: rest) (hne : a.cap ≠ b.cap)
    {x : Point d} (heq : a.value x = b.value x) :
    x ∈ properTieWalls base rest :=

all_public_private_headers.name: off_wall_distinct_values
all_public_private_headers.header:
theorem off_wall_distinct_values {d : ℕ}
    (base : LabeledBranch d) (rest : List (LabeledBranch d))
    {x : Point d} (hx : x ∉ properTieWalls base rest)
    {a b : LabeledBranch d} (ha : a ∈ base :: rest)
    (hb : b ∈ base :: rest) (hne : a.cap ≠ b.cap) :
    a.value x ≠ b.value x :=
